introduction: Nevada TANF provides cash and related support for qualifying families with dependent children. Access Nevada is the state’s online application and case-management route.
description: Nevada TANF provides cash and related support for qualifying families with dependent children. Access Nevada is the state’s online application and case-management route.

sections.who: DSS considers family circumstances, financial eligibility and the relevant program category. Parents and non-parent relatives caring for dependent children may be considered; work-related requirements depend on the case.
sections.get: Cash assistance can be accompanied by employment-related case management and support such as childcare or transportation. The NEON category serves households with a work-eligible individual.
sections.docs:
• Household income and identity information.
  • Children’s ages and caregiver relationship details.
  • Housing and other requested financial records.
  • Employment circumstances and evidence supporting an exemption when relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Request cash assistance

    Use Access Nevada and identify each family member involved.

  2. Complete the eligibility review

    Respond to DSS interview or document instructions and explain non-parent caregiving or other relevant circumstances.

  3. Discuss the program category

    Ask which cash program applies and what employment or support-service plan is required.
sections.after: Read reporting and participation notices. Tell the worker about barriers such as unavailable childcare and ask how to document them; do not assume the same obligations apply to every family.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Nevada TANF purpose and application, Cash-program categories. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can a relative caregiver ask for assistance?
The state lists non-parent relatives caring for dependent children among its cash-program applicants.
The state describes cash assistance, case management and support aimed at addressing employment barriers for work-eligible households.
Does one application settle every program requirement?
No. DSS still reviews eligibility and explains category-specific participation and reporting requirements.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
